Opened institutional notes support Nocturnes premiere/Whistler context, Ravel quartet history and Miroirs premiere. Sibley documents the adapted Hokusai cover detail. reviewed.arrangements: EXT: opened Commons credits identify Lawrence Odom/US Air Force Band and Thomas Knox/US Marine Band. Both excerpts are explicitly called concert-band arrangements, and no absent original string section is falsely identified in their sound.
reviewed.rights: EXT: exact Monet, Hokusai and Bakst Commons files exist and carry public-domain notices. Their dates/subjects match the captions. Monet is an editorial comparison, Hokusai a documented score-cover connection, Bakst a theatrical design rather than an alleged portrait or direct sonic cause.
reviewed.style: MEAS: nine stations, three-sentence introduction, subtitle and station titles within limits, 60–140-word narration and cues no longer than 25 words. British spelling, typographic quotes and accidental symbols retained. Both influence ids exist.
